patterns.note: The site uses full-bleed, high-resolution imagery and video as section dividers and hero backgrounds, creating immersive visual breaks between content blocks.
Headings are set in an elegant serif typeface, while body text and smaller labels use a clean sans-serif, often in uppercase for emphasis.
A strong contrast is established between a very dark brown/charcoal background and white text, and a light beige background with dark brown/charcoal text, defining distinct content areas.

The initial hero section features a dynamic visual background (likely a video or auto-advancing slider) that changes its content (e.g., from a plane to a watch close-up) while the main title remains consistent.
Upon scrolling past the initial hero, the navigation bar becomes fixed to the top of the viewport, maintaining its dark background and white text.
Content is organized into distinct, generously spaced sections, often introduced by a large, centered serif heading and a brief sans-serif description.

technique_notes: The hero section employs a full-width video or image carousel that auto-plays or transitions between high-resolution visuals, creating an immersive introduction (using 'video-hero' or 'swiper' technology).
The primary navigation bar uses a sticky positioning effect, where it remains visible at the top of the screen after the user scrolls past the initial hero content.
Content sections are introduced with generous vertical spacing, using full-bleed imagery and alternating light and dark background colors to define distinct areas of information.

design_tokens.type_scale: oversized elegant serif headings (~3-4x body) paired with legible sans-serif body text and small uppercase sans-serif labels.
design_tokens.spacing: airy — very generous vertical spacing between sections, balanced spacing within content blocks.

standout: This site's design is distinctive for its sophisticated use of full-bleed, high-quality product and lifestyle photography, which acts as both content and visual dividers. The dynamic hero section, which changes its visual content while maintaining a central message, creates a luxurious and immersive brand experience that immediately conveys exclusivity and craftsmanship.
